description: This file defines the Zend_Validate_Hostname class, which validates hostnames including DNS, IP addresses, and local network names, with support for IDN and TLD validation.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_Hostname
classes.description: A class for validating hostnames, supporting DNS, IP, and local names, with options for IDN and TLD validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the hostname validator with options for allowed hostname types, IDN validation, TLD validation, and IP validator.

methods.name: setIpValidator
methods.description: Sets the IP validator used for IP address validation.

methods.name: getAllow
methods.description: Returns the current allow bitmask for hostname types.

methods.name: setAllow
methods.description: Sets the allow bitmask for hostname types.

methods.name: setValidateIdn
methods.description: Enables or disables IDN hostname validation.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates a hostname string against current options, including DNS, IP, and local name schemas.
